  name: 'phase-screen-checks',
  description: 'Two independent checks (statistics and process) of the phase screen reading before it is reported',

const TRANSCRIPT = '/root/.claude/projects/-home-user-mesozoic-labs/184ee67c-2802-5235-8e52-6dc7daa72cd3.jsonl'

const COMMON = `
CONTEXT: PS = ${PS} is a finished, pinned CPU screen (report only): 8 PPO continuations of the T. rex r10 stance policy from s42's 2,097,152 checkpoint to E = 3,538,944, 4 control and 4 critic_phase (only the critic sees the episode phase in command slots 60-62; the actor unchanged), paired seeds 2901/2911/2921/2931. Its pre-registration is ${PS}/criteria.txt (0444, pinned by ${PS}/APPROVED with SCREEN.json and six tools). The runner exited 0 at 20:18:54Z with all 8 COUNTED and read; the pinned scorer ${PS}/tools/score_bs.py wrote ${PS}/score/score.{json,txt} at 20:19:27Z: line 2, REDUCED, p 1/70; secondaries SEC-CMD, SEC-MARGIN, SEC-MECH SUPPORTED (1/70 each) and the guard SEC-TAIL2 SUPPORTED (2/70). Nothing is reported to the maintainer until two independent checks agree. The run log is ${RUNLOG} (read only).
RULES: Write ONLY under your own folder (given below); set TMPDIR and MPLCONFIGDIR inside it. Never modify anything else (PS's files, the run log, the repo). Never redirect output to any path outside your folder, and never reference the null device (/dev/null) in any form. No git or network writes, no training. Python: ${PY}. The pinned V-G tool may be running at nice 19 on one core; keep your heavy work at nice 10 or more. Label every claim [measured] or [inferred]. Keep a command log with date -u times in your folder. If a permission check refuses something, stop and report it.
`

const STAT = `You are the INDEPENDENT STATISTICS CHECKER of a finished screen's reading. ${COMMON}
Your folder: ${PS}/check/stat (create it).
Re-derive the reading WITH YOUR OWN CODE from the raw records, without importing score_bs.py or read_bs.py (you may read their source to learn file formats, and you may read the criteria text). Specifically:
1. B_S from the parent's probe rows ending at S as the criteria define it; each COUNTED continuation's PRIMARY (the mean of the on-policy tail_3 command over the 8 probe rows with update_timesteps 3,473,408 ... 3,530,752) from its own records (runs/<name>/... policy_probe.npz or wherever the criteria say), the gate (control median rise >= 0.20 by the criteria's median rule), and the exact one-sided permutation p over all C(8,4) = 70 splits with the criteria's statistic and fill rule. Line text per the criteria.
2. The four secondaries exactly as the criteria define them (data source, direction, fill, test, Bonferroni note), from the raw records where possible (CMD_L from the evaluation ledger at E; b* = 1 - G - c0 and the critic's on-policy tail slope from the markers, cross-checking the markers' internal consistency; tail_2 from the probe column 13).
3. Compare every number in score.json / score.txt's reading, primary, gate, test, paired differences and secondaries with yours (exact or float round-off); list any difference.
4. The spread caveat, as BS2's report gave it: arm SDs, and under a normal model with no mean shift but this SD ratio, the probability of complete separation (all 4 control above all 4 phase); also a post hoc Welch t and one-sided p (report only). Note that the pre-registered p decides.
5. Read the score's MANIPULATION and report-only sections and confirm they are consistent with run_meta / check.json (CHECK passed, 175 rollouts, the arm signatures).
Write ${PS}/check/stat/NOTES.txt and SHA256SUMS.txt. Return the structured result.`

const PROC = `You are the INDEPENDENT PROCESS CHECKER of a finished screen. ${COMMON}
Your folder: ${PS}/check/proc (create it).
Audit, with your own scripts:
1. Pins: APPROVED's sha256 values equal criteria.txt, SCREEN.json and the six tools now; criteria.txt, SCREEN.json and APPROVED are 0444; the run log holds APPROVED's sha256 and its exact bytes (tail line check at the pin entry) BEFORE the launch entry (15:56:58Z); every run_meta.json of the 8 COUNTED continuations (and of the retired *_crashed* folders) records APPROVED's sha256 and the tools' digests at its start; the code seal 331fe8fc... unchanged.
2. Run handling against criteria.txt RUN HANDLING and run_waves_bs.sh: the container restarted twice (about 18:07Z and 18:53Z), killing the second wave; the coordinator relaunched the runner at 18:08:57Z and 18:55:53Z; the runner retired the half-way runs to runs/<name>_crashed1 and _crashed2 as crashes NOT counted (status 'running', not 'crashed'), and reran each from the start pair with the same seed and arguments (attempt3 are the counted ones). Verify from logs/run_waves_bs.log, crash_ledger.tsv, decided.tsv and run_meta: the rules were followed exactly; no crashed folder was read (atimes); each COUNTED continuation is one complete attempt from S to E with stop reason 'end'; no VOID, no LOST, no HALTED; CHECK passed on all 8. Judge whether a container restart is correctly handled as a not-counted crash under the criteria's wording (cite lines), and say if the wording leaves any doubt.
3. Outcome-blindness: (a) the atime snapshots (logs/atimes_at_exit/*.tsv, logs/atimes_at_ALL_DECIDED.tsv) show no outcome-bearing file read between each continuation's exit and ALL_DECIDED other than by CHECK; (b) the coordinator's transcript ${TRANSCRIPT} (JSONL; read only; search tool_use inputs of Bash and Read calls with timestamps between 2026-10-31T15:56:58Z and 2026-10-31T20:18:54Z) never opened, listed the contents of, or hashed anything under ${PS}/runs, ${PS}/reads, ${PS}/score, ${PS}/lost.json, ${PS}/tmp or the continuation attempt logs, and never ran the scorer before the runner exited; list every call that touched ${PS} in that window and classify it. Known items to assess, not assume: an 'ls ${PS}/logs/' at about 15:57Z (file names), the VG checker's find -newermt over /home/user/work (mtimes of PS top-level entries; its own report), the coordinator's stderr redirect to /dev/zero at 19:35Z, the VG builder's listing of /tmp/tb_buffer. Also check the workflow sub-agent transcripts under /root/.claude/projects/-home-user-mesozoic-labs/184ee67c-2802-5235-8e52-6dc7daa72cd3/subagents/workflows/wf_848c7e6d-0a1/ for any access to PS outcome paths.
4. The separately pinned V-G tool: its seven sha256 lines are in the run log before ALL_DECIDED (20:06:54Z) and equal the files in /home/user/work/vg_tool now.
5. The scorer ran once after the runner exited (20:19:27Z), on the pinned bytes; score.json STATUS final with no PROVISIONAL item; the earlier prelaunch_score (15:56Z) was 'incomplete 0 of 8'.
6. Anything else in the process that could undermine the reading (e.g. repository changes during the screen: PR #657 is docs-only and the screen runs from a sealed code copy; verify the screen never imported the repo checkout).
Write ${PS}/check/proc/NOTES.txt and SHA256SUMS.txt. Return the structured result.`

const SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    agree: { type: 'boolean', description: 'true if the reading and its process stand as scored' },
    summary: { type: 'string' },
    key_numbers: { type: 'string' },
    findings: {
      type: 'array',
      items: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          id: { type: 'string' },
          severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['blocking', 'minor', 'info'] },
          claim: { type: 'string' },
          evidence: { type: 'string' },
        },
        required: ['id', 'severity', 'claim', 'evidence'],
      },
    },
  },
  required: ['agree', 'summary', 'key_numbers', 'findings'],
}

phase('Check')
const [stat, proc] = await parallel([
  () => agent(STAT, { label: 'check:stat', phase: 'Check', schema: SCHEMA }),
  () => agent(PROC, { label: 'check:proc', phase: 'Check', schema: SCHEMA }),
])
return { stat, proc }
